note: Counted by hand from the table under the heading "Services that support the kms:ViaService condition key" on https://docs.aws.amazon.com/kms/latest/developerguide/conditions-kms.html. That table is the ONLY coverage statement on the page: its lead sentence is "The following table lists AWS services that are integrated with AWS KMS and support the use of the kms:ViaService condition key in customer managed keys". The service principals ec2.us-west-2.amazonaws.com, rds.us-west-2.amazonaws.com and lambda.us-west-2.amazonaws.com that appear earlier in the same section sit inside example IAM policy documents and are NOT counted; nor is Amazon EBS in the kms:GrantIsForAWSResource prose, nor Amazon Cognito in an encryption-context example, nor AWS CloudTrail in the kms:TrailingDaysWithoutKeyUsage advice. Condition keys, API operation names and the us-east-1 / eu-west-3 / ap-southeast-2 Region names used in kms:PrimaryRegion and kms:ReplicaRegion examples are not axis items either; kms:ReplicaRegion links out to the endpoints and quotas page for the Region list, which is a link, not a list. The table has 96 rows. Four rows (Amazon Aurora, Amazon Neptune, Amazon RDS Performance Insights, Amazon Relational Database Service (Amazon RDS)) all carry the rds ViaService name and the universe models them as the single service rds, so they count once, dropping 3. Amazon DocumentDB is an alias of rds in the universe but its row carries the docdb-elastic ViaService name, which is a service of its own, so it is counted as docdb-elastic. Four rows resolve to no IAM service and are recorded as unresolved, not counted: Amazon Chime SDK (chimevoiceconnector, and the name is ambiguous between chime and identity-chime), AWS DeepRacer (deepracer is not a service and the name matches only the product:aws-deepracer catalogue row, which has no IAM prefix), Amazon OpenSearch Custom Packages (custom-packages) and Amazon Replicated Data Store (ards). 96 - 3 - 4 = 89. Three are partial: ec2, because the cell reads "(EBS only)"; bedrock, because the row names only Amazon Bedrock Model Copy; and guardduty, because its ViaService name is malware-protection, which reaches GuardDuty Malware Protection only.
